summary: MoonWalk es un juego en Godot donde niños de 7 a 12 años manejan un puesto lunar y tienen que sobrevivir hasta el día 7. Equilibran oxígeno, agua, comida, energía y radiación mientras reparan módulos, cultivan, minan minerales y responden a eventos (fallas, tormenta de polvo y llamaradas solares).
details:
It is a survival game set on the moon, solar flares are a risk that we do not perceive thanks to the Earth's magnetic field. However, even if an eruption is small, it can release many particles and vice versa. Using a JSON and we calculate and set these flagarations, their duration and their damage to the player.

It is encoded in GDScript, made in godot. The factors that my team considers are the weight of the spacesuit, the scarcity of resources, the management and tradeoff of the variables introduced.
